newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Agip to shut Singapore bunkering office - sources.
newsitem.headline: Agip to shut Singapore bunkering office - sources.

text.p: Italy's Agip SpA is to close its Singapore office dealing with bunkering and lubricant operations by October 31, industry sources said on Thursday.
"Agip is closing down the Singapore branch by the end of October," said a source close to the company.
Agip officials were not immediately available for comment.
Agip recently chartered a 6,000-tonne barge for its bunkering business and has term storage in Singapore for bunkering, traders said.
Industry sources said Agip would assign a local agent to run the company's current lubricating business after closing the office.
